title: Concept: Maven parent declared with a version range
description: pom.xml declares a parent POM version written as a range, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The dependency management the build inherits changes with every matching parent release, so reviewed versions can move without a commit.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The dependency management the build inherits changes with every matching parent release, so reviewed versions can move without a commit.
